title: Uruguayan-Style Rice Bowl
description: A hearty bowl filled with flavorful rice, wholesome beans, and a hint of Uruguay's culinary traditions. Serve as a comforting meal or a satisfying side dish.

ingredients.name: canned black beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add diced bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add diced tomato and cook for 2 minutes.
Add Uruguayan soup mix and stir to combine. Cook for 1 minute.
Add black beans and stir to combine.
Add wholesome rice to the saucepan and stir to combine with the soup mixture.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the rice mixture with a fork and stir in chopped cilantro.
